svg.title: The path of one reading
svg.desc: A sensor's reading is published on the board's event bus, framed and sealed by the transport, and sent over the link to the gateway. The gateway checks the frame and appends one record per signal to its outbox. Mesh polls the outbox, stores the readings, acknowledges them and appends them to the project's live feed. The application follows the feed over HTTP or MQTT, refreshes its widgets and runs its rules, and the browser receives the changed card over Server-Sent Events.
svg.text: Board
the driver publishes a reading on the event bus; robohub-telemetry
hands it to the transport, which frames it and seals it with the session key
UART · USB · Wi-Fi — COBS frames with a tag and a counter
Gateway
checks the session, counter and tag; keeps the latest values; appends
one record per signal to its durable outbox, with a sequence number
GET /api/v1/telemetry/outbox?after=<seq>
Mesh
polls each gateway with a token for that gateway; writes the page in one
transaction, keyed by gateway and sequence; then acknowledges it
POST /api/v1/telemetry/ack
Telemetry store and live feed
latest value, raw history, minute and hourly roll-ups, per source;
each new reading is appended to the project's live feed
the live feed, over SSE or MQTT
Application
provider-mesh follows the feed into a file (gateway.follow); the background
loop sees it grow, refreshes the widgets and runs the rules, which read
values with gateway.source_latest
Server-Sent Events: the changed card, as HTML
Browser
HTMX swaps the card in; one event stream per page, nothing polls
a switch: hx-post → gateway.action → Mesh → gateway → board
Teal boxes hold keys: the gateway derives each board's key from its own; Mesh holds the gateway keys
and asks the keeper for short-lived tokens. The browser never sees Mesh, a gateway or a token.
